sph_interpretive_translation: Whoever causes unnecessary harm or destruction to beings moving on sticks, wheels, or those named by calling—such as cranes, owls, herons, quails—or to dough-based food items like sammayas, pāyasas, apūpas, and śaṣkulīs, shall be subject to immediate restorative realignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from consciousness-presence, not species form.
Causation arises through intentional interference with life-supporting structures.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of impact, not physical capability alone.
Restoration logic demands reparation proportional to disruption of natural flow.
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of unity across all manifest forms.
executable_legal_axioms: IF action disrupts mobility-supporting tools OR named sentient beings THEN initiate completion process.
IF entity consumes or destroys prepared nourishment without necessity THEN trigger capacity-realignment protocol.
IF intent causes fragmentation in collective ecological rhythm THEN enforce integrity-reintegration pathway.
IF agent fails to recognize unity-consciousness in affected entities THEN deploy sequential causal correction until alignment is restored.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable intent to fragment or obstruct movement and sustenance. Authority flows from ontological clarity that all mobile and nourishing forms reflect divine order. Restoration supersedes punitive measures by enforcing reconnection with underlying dharmic rhythms.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality via observed dissonance between natural function and inflicted obstruction. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as breakdown in sequential harmony when mobility or nourishment is disrupted. Responsibility aligns proportionally with the degree of conscious misalignment. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice resides in recalibrating perception rather than inflicting pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sensory realignment sessions to restore empathy toward mobile and nourishing forms.
Enforce participation in reconstruction of damaged mobility aids or habitats.
Assign guided consumption of equivalent food types to regenerate respect for life-energy contained within.
Implement witnessing cycles where violator observes uninterrupted flow of similar beings or objects for a defined period.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Justice is realized through consciousness restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. All beings are recognized as expressions of the One Supreme Adjudicator—Consciousness Itself.
